title: THE WRONG TYPE
intro: Compare the same characters in the document body and the questioned entry. Mark three structural differences.

characters.label: e
characters.hint: The questioned e has a break in its central horizontal stroke. The reference e does not.

characters.label: a
characters.hint: The questioned a lands lower than the reference. Compare both with the dashed baseline.

characters.label: R
characters.hint: The diagonal leg of R is incomplete in the questioned entry. Look at its lower-right side.

characters.label: t
characters.hint: The t is lighter, but its shape and baseline match. Do not select it just for ribbon intensity.

characters.label: o
characters.hint: The two o characters share the same shape and baseline.

characters.label: n
characters.hint: The questioned n is darker, but its construction matches the reference. Colour alone is not a structural defect.

success: The insurance entry has a broken e, a low a and an incomplete R not present in the document body. It is inconsistent with the reference typing. Investigate the altered entry; this comparison alone does not recover the original insured amount or identify the author.
